cards.ex: We might see some improvements down the line, but not immediately.
cards.exUz: Kelajakda ba'zi yaxshilanishlarni ko'rishimiz mumkin, lekin hozir emas.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, vaqt o'tishi bilan sodir bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: The new policy is starting to gain traction among employees.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat xodimlar orasida ommaviylasha boshladi.
cards.uzDef: G'oya, mahsulot yoki harakat tobora ko'proq qiziqish va qo'llab-quvvatlashga ega bo'lishi.

cards.ex: These reforms will set the stage for economic growth.
cards.exUz: Ushbu islohotlar iqtisodiy o'sish uchun zamin yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi voqealar, o'zgarishlar yoki natijalar uchun sharoit yaratish.

cards.ex: He's riding the wave of popularity after his viral video.
cards.exUz: U virusli videosidan keyin mashhurlik to'lqinida suzmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ommabop yoki muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgan narsadan foydalanish.

cards.ex: The election was a watershed moment in the country's history.
cards.exUz: Saylovlar mamlakat tarixida burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim voqea yoki o'zgarishning boshlanishi.

cards.ex: The company is on the cusp of a major breakthrough.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya katta yutuq arfasida turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Yaqinda sodir bo'ladigan narsa yoki holatning oldida turish.

cards.ex: The band's success was just a flash in the pan.
cards.exUz: Guruhning muvaffaqiyati faqat bir zumlik hodisa edi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida mashhur bo'lgan, lekin tezda unutiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: You can't turn back the clock; you have to move forward.
cards.exUz: Vaqtni orqaga qaytarib bo'lmaydi; oldinga harakat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi holatga qaytishga urinish, odatda, imkonsiz bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Many small businesses bit the dust during the recession.
cards.exUz: Inqiroz davrida ko'plab kichik bizneslar mag'lub bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Mag'lub bo'lish, ishdan chiqish yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: It's a race against time to find a cure for the disease.
cards.exUz: Bu kasallikka davo topish uchun vaqtga qarshi poyga.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt tugashidan oldin biror narsani tugatishga urinish.

cards.ex: They jumped the gun and announced the product launch too early.
cards.exUz: Ular shoshilishdi va mahsulotning ishga tushirilishini juda erta e'lon qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtidan oldin yoki shoshilib harakat qilish.

cards.ex: This reform is long overdue and should have been implemented years ago.
cards.exUz: Bu islohot ancha kechikkan va uni bir necha yil oldin amalga oshirish kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ancha vaqtdan beri qilinishi kerak bo'lgan, juda kech qolgan narsa.

cards.ex: The campaign is gathering momentum as more people become aware of the issue.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya ko'proq odamlar muammodan xabardor bo'lgani sayin kuchayib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jarayon yoki g'oya tobora ko'proq kuchayib, tezlashib bormoqda.

cards.ex: Using typewriters is pretty much a thing of the past now.
cards.exUz: Yozuv mashinkalaridan foydalanish hozir deyarli o'tmishda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Endi mavjud bo'lmagan yoki amal qilmaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: Let the investigation take its course; we shouldn't interfere.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv o'z yo'lini tutsin, biz aralashmasligimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning tabiiy ravishda rivojlanishiga ruxsat berish, aralashmaslik.

cards.ex: The project is running ahead of schedule, which is great news.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muddatdan oldin bajarilmoqda, bu ajoyib yangilik.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan vaqtdan erta tugallangan yoki amalga oshirilgan.

cards.ex: After his arrest, he decided to turn over a new leaf and get his life together.
cards.exUz: Hibsdan so'ng u yangi sahifa ochishga va hayotini tartibga solishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z hayotini yaxshilash uchun yangi yo'l boshlamoq.

cards.ex: The regulations will remain in place for the foreseeable future.
cards.exUz: Qoidalar yaqin kelajakda kuchda qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakning yaqin davrida, ko'ra oladigan vaqt oralig'ida.

cards.ex: His popularity is on the wane after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin uning mashhurligi kamayib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning kuchi, ahamiyati yoki miqdori kamayib bormoqda.

cards.ex: I've set the wheels in motion to find a new apartment.
cards.exUz: Men yangi kvartira topish uchun harakatlarni boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash uchun zarur bo'lgan harakatlarni qilish.

cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Alkogol ichish va haydash - halokat sababi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib keladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline for next year.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi yil uchun bir nechta yangi loyihalarimiz rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda ishlab chiqilayotgan yoki rejalashtirilayotgan.

cards.ex: Down the road, we might consider expanding our business.
cards.exUz: Kelajakda biz biznesimizni kengaytirishni o'ylab ko'rishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, keyinroq vaqtda.

cards.ex: The party got out of hand and the neighbors called the police.
cards.exUz: Kechki ovqat nazoratdan chiqib ketdi va qo'shnilar politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Nazorat qilib bo'lmaydigan holatga kelmoq.

cards.ex: The project is on track to be completed by the deadline.
cards.exUz: Loyiha belgilangan muddatga qadar tugallanishi rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilganidek rivojlanmoq.

cards.ex: This new technology is a real game changer for the industry.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi texnologiya sanoat uchun haqiqiy o'zgarishga olib keluvchi narsa.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tubdan o'zgartiradigan narsa yoki voqea.

cards.ex: Many people are resistant to change and prefer the status quo.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar o'zgarishga qarshilik ko'rsatadilar va mavjud holatni afzal ko'radilar.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaziyat yoki sharoit.

cards.ex: His views on technology are a bit behind the times.
cards.exUz: Uning texnologiya haqidagi qarashlari biroz zamondan orqada.
cards.uzDef: Eski uslubda, zamonaviy tendensiyalardan bexabar.

cards.ex: Lowering standards could be a slippery slope to lower quality.
cards.exUz: Standartlarni pasaytirish sifatning pasayishiga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan xavfli yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kichik bir qadam salbiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: This company has come a long way in just a few years.
cards.exUz: Bu kompaniya bir necha yil ichida uzoq yo'l bosib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta yutuqlarga erishmoq, sezilarli darajada yaxshilanmoq.
